verdict.rationale: Eqvista's round-modeling tool shows cap-table dilution from new investment, accounts for a new option pool, and takes pre-money/post-money valuation and investment-amount inputs. The analysis exports as a downloadable PDF meant for sharing with stakeholders, and a hands-on user praised the round-modeling feature. SAFEs can be added to the cap table, and note conversion via the price-per-share method is documented, but SAFE conversion inside the round model is not explicitly shown. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE conversion within the priced-round model, an explicit pro-forma ownership table, and collaborative or live scenario sharing with counsel and investors beyond a PDF export.
